title: Building UAVLab as a Multi-Sensor Navigation Sandbox
dek: Project notes on a local WebGL environment for UAV dynamics, GNSS, urban navigation, and sensor fusion.
body: UAVLab is an open-source engineering sandbox that runs locally in a web browser. It brings together a 3D city environment, UAV motion, multi-constellation GNSS, inertial sensing, LiDAR, cameras, atmospheric effects, and urban signal blockage.

The simulator is designed for exploration and education rather than certified flight or navigation. It supports comparisons between weighted least squares, 3D mapping-aided methods, NLOS weighting, and factor graph optimization using synthetic scenarios.
